source.title: Overshooting of Hypoplastic Models With Intergranular Strain: Manifestation, Implications and Remedy
source.locator: Section2.3 Example3, paragraphs before and after Figures4-5; Table5
source.access: Publisher HTML full text; no local full-text snapshot pinned.

published_modelling_convention.scope: Numerical oedometer examples using Karlsruhe Fine Sand and Zbraslav parameters; not a newly reported measurement of the 2016 specimens.
published_modelling_convention.history: Vertically mobilized intergranular state h_yy=-R; ISA centre c_yy=-R/2. These are model-specific initialization assumptions.

decisions.what_this_closes: A primary published example explicitly supplies lateral stress and internal-history initialization for a KFS-parameter oedometer simulation.
decisions.what_remains_open: The original specimen lateral stress and hidden history remain unmeasured in the reviewed sources. This does not choose the correct state for OE1/OE12, resolve void-ratio disagreements, establish a base-law history, or validate a loading coordinate.
decisions.configuration_change: none; existing archived sensitivity scenarios and fits preserved
decisions.response_access: No reserved or unassigned experimental response files accessed. Publisher numerical examples were exposed.

next_step: If adopting a Jaky initialization sensitivity, predeclare it as an assumption with exact model phi_c, sign and history mapping; compare numerical sensitivity without selecting it by best experimental fit.
